# PokéDB Data

This branch contains the validated JSON datasets generated by the
[`PokéDB`](https://github.com/pokelitee/pokedb) package. The complete corpus
is regenerated weekly from structured [PokéAPI](https://pokeapi.co/) data.

## Data contract

- The current format is schema version 5.
- Every `genN` directory is a cumulative catalog of resources introduced by or
  before that generation.
- Generation output is not a claim that every resource is obtainable in every
  game. Version-group maps identify game-specific values where PokéAPI exposes
  them.
- Structural field names use `snake_case`. PokéAPI identifiers retain their
  canonical kebab-case spelling.
- `null` means unavailable or inapplicable for that generation. Empty
  collections mean the modeled mechanic applies but has no entries.
- Move, item, and Pokémon records carry an `unverified_historical_fields`
  array (empty for the latest generation) naming fields whose value is
  backfilled from current PokéAPI data because PokéAPI keeps no
  per-generation history for them, rather than a value verified for that
  generation.

PokéAPI does not provide complete item-introduction history. Item catalogs use
structured game-index evidence plus item references from generated machines,
held items, and evolution conditions. They are referentially complete, but do
not claim to enumerate every unreferenced item available in each historical
game.

## Layout

```text
genN/
|-- index.json
|-- ability/
|-- item/
|-- move/
`-- pokemon/
    |-- default/
    |-- variant/
    |-- transformation/
    `-- cosmetic/
```

Every `index.json` contains source and generation metadata, stable resource
summary arrays, counts, generated-catalog identifiers, a content digest, and
per-catalog generator provenance. All resource keys are present even when their list
is empty.

## Static API

Use `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pokelitee/pokedb/data` as the base URL.

- Generation 9 index:
  [`/gen9/index.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pokelitee/pokedb/data/gen9/index.json)
- Generation 9 Pikachu:
  [`/gen9/pokemon/default/pikachu.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pokelitee/pokedb/data/gen9/pokemon/default/pikachu.json)
- Generation 9 Ice Stone:
  [`/gen9/item/ice-stone.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pokelitee/pokedb/data/gen9/item/ice-stone.json)

See the project [API documentation](https://github.com/pokelitee/pokedb/wiki/API-Documentation)
and [data model](https://github.com/pokelitee/pokedb/wiki/Data-Model) for the
full contract.

Machine assignments are objects keyed by version group, with item identifiers or
`null` values. Historical parent species agree with the reconstructed evolution
chain. Historical cosmetic sprites are empty when no form-specific historical
assets are available.

For reproducible consumption, replace `data` in the base URL with an immutable
`data-v<schema>-<run-id>-<attempt>` tag or a full data commit SHA.

## Compatibility

Schema versions 1 through 4 are incompatible with schema version 5. Consumers
should read `metadata.schema_version` from the generation index before loading
resource files.
